# Button

The one way to start an action: primary, secondary, ghost, danger and subtle, in three sizes.

`Zorix.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<Zorix.Button />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Zorix.Button"></x-import>
```

| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  |
